Krylya Sovetov vs CSKA Moscow Live Stream — Watch Online Free

Krylya Sovetov Samara welcome CSKA Moscow to the Solidarnost Samara Arena on Tuesday, 7 April 2026 in the Russian Cup (Regions Path, Semi-finals). Krylya Sovetov have shown fighting spirit this season and will use home advantage to challenge one of Russia's traditional powerhouses. CSKA Moscow, with their rich history and squad quality, are aiming to progress deep into the cup while managing their domestic league commitments.

The hosts will look to make the game physical and compact, relying on the passionate Samara crowd to create pressure. CSKA are expected to control possession and use their technical superiority and attacking depth to break down the home defence. This matchup often delivers intensity, with Krylya Sovetov known for making life difficult for bigger sides at home.

Kick-off: 07.04.2026, 15:00 UTC (19:00 local time in Samara)

They will aim to limit CSKA’s space and create danger on the counter or from set-pieces. CSKA Moscow prefer a more possession-based approach with high pressing and fluid attacking movements involving their creative midfielders and forwards.

The tactical battle will centre on whether CSKA can break down Krylya’s compact block without leaving themselves exposed to fast counters. Krylya Sovetov’s best chance lies in staying patient and exploiting any overcommitment from the visitors. The home atmosphere at Solidarnost Samara Arena could play a significant role in energising the hosts.

Krylya Sovetov have shown mixed but competitive form, often performing above expectations against stronger opponents at home. Their strength lies in a well-organised defensive structure and counter-attacking threat. Key players include goalkeeper Sergei Pesyakov, defenders Nikita Chernov and Dmitri Oroz who provide stability, midfielders Maxim Vityugov and Sergey Babkin who control the engine room, and forward Ivan Oleynikov who brings pace and creativity in attack.

CSKA Moscow: Recent Form & Key Players

CSKA Moscow have been consistent this season with a strong squad capable of competing on multiple fronts. They blend defensive solidity with dangerous attacking play. Standout performers include experienced defenders, creative midfielders who dictate tempo, and forwards who offer movement and clinical finishing. CSKA’s depth allows them to maintain intensity, though away games against motivated home sides can present challenges.
